📐 Sales Calculation Methodology

1. Dual Independent Ingestion: Customer Invoices (Sales) and Credit Notes (Sales Returns) are uploaded into independent datasets (window.__SALES_STATE__ and window.__SALES_RETURN_STATE__).

2. Authoritative Monetary Fields: Ingestion relies strictly on Before VAT, Tax, and Total.

3. Math Reconciliation: Every row is checked against Total = Before VAT + Tax. Mismatches are flagged in Data Quality without mutating original values.

4. Sales Return Calculation: Sales Returns are uploaded with positive amounts. The calculation engine subtracts returns when computing Net Sales.

5. Net Metrics:
• Net Sales Before VAT = SUM(Sales.beforeVAT) - SUM(SalesReturn.beforeVAT)
• Net Tax = SUM(Sales.tax) - SUM(SalesReturn.tax)
• Net Sales Including VAT = SUM(Sales.total) - SUM(SalesReturn.total)

📖 Sales Control Tower Operational Guide

• Independent Uploads: Go to Sales & Return Upload to upload either sales.xlsx (Customer Invoices) or sales_return.xlsx (Credit Notes).

• Exact Schema: Both files must contain: Date, Invoice Number, Partner Name, Sales Person, Branch, Before VAT, Tax, Total, Type.

• Type Requirements: Type must be Customer Invoice for Sales and Credit Note for Sales Returns.

• Combined Analytics: Daily MIS, Branch, Salesperson, Customer, and Ledger automatically combine both streams dynamically.

• Drilldown: Click on any customer, salesperson, branch, or invoice to inspect underlying transactions with their source.

📐 Calculation Methodology & Audit Governance

1. Due Date Calculation

Due Date = Invoice Date + Master Credit Days

2. Overdue Days Calculation

Overdue Days = As-of Date - Due Date

3. Over Risk Definition

Over Risk = Overdue Days ≥ 6 (Buckets 6-10 D through Above 40 D)

4. Over Limit Formula

Over Limit Amount = MAX(Total Receivables - Credit Limit, 0)

5. Indicative Balance for Collection

Indicative Balance = MAX(Total Overdue - Recorded Collections, 0)

*Audit Notice: Cash receipts are matched by Customer Name and are not allocated to individual invoices due to the absence of invoice allocation references in receipt source files.

📖 Operating Guide: Receivables & Collection Tower

  1. Step 1: Upload your Invoice Excel file (Required: Customer Name, Invoice Date, Amount Due).
  2. Step 2: Upload your Customer Credit Master (Required: Customer Name, Salesman, Branch, Promissory, Credit Limit, Credit Days).
  3. Step 3: (Optional) Upload Collection Receipt Excel (Date, Number, Journal, Branch, Salesperson, Customer Name, Amount, Status) or click Load Live Demo Dataset.
  4. Step 4: Select your As-of Calculation Date in the top bar.
  5. Step 5: Click Generate Executive Report to execute client-side calculations and audits.
  6. Step 6: Navigate between analytical tabs or click any customer name to inspect Customer 360.
  7. Step 7: Click Download FINORA AR Workbook to export the formula-driven workbook.

How balances are calculated
  • Debit = amount due from the To Company; Credit = amount due to the To Company, as recorded by the From Company. Net = Debit − Credit.
  • Gross = Net + Tax, with tax added on the side of the entry (tax on a credit-side entry increases the credit amount). Debit, Credit and Tax are never altered by these calculations.
  • Company Wise: every transaction is shown for both companies; the To Company sees the mirror image (Debit ↔ Credit), so the Net Balance column adds to zero across all companies. Tax appears on both sides, so its total is not summed.
  • Open Balance and Settled Amount are on a Gross basis: positive = receivable, negative = payable, from that company's point of view.
  • Cancelled transactions stay in the ledger but are excluded from every total, KPI and outstanding balance.
  • Overview, Company Wise and Settlement figures show one currency at a time (no FX conversion). The ledger Grand Total shows one row per currency.
